method: Integer layout/accounting only; no scientific inputs generated or evaluated.
partialFailureAllowance: A failed family retains its own prefix/full backing arrays, not permission for a replacement. Conservatively reserve another maximum family backing set for duplicated-prefix persistence. Actual writer cap always governs.
mainHostArrays: Original 136N; candidate/R/Q-prepared 3*224N; packed 112N; R/Q outputs 960N; GPU 256N; H 288N; R/Q/GPU policy 8N². Extra generator/metadata/JSON/filesystem buffers within fixed reserve; JS object/GC and browser overhead checked by sampled RSS.
limitations: This payload ledger is not a proof of total host/driver memory; sampled owned-process RSS is separately enforced at 4 GiB. Counts are not performance evidence.
